integrity: Exact integer annihilator on 4096 paired transfer states and 64 fixed transfer states; separate exhaustive microscopic implementation through seven columns. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to labelled binary majority configurations on open Cartesian strips P_n square K_3 with n>=2 and incumbent tie retention; counts immediate recurrent states, not attraction basins or transient lengths. An earlier unindexed equivalent result remains possible.
title: Exact two-cycle entropy for majority dynamics on open triangular strips
